# openwebui_code_execution_config (Resource)

Manages code execution and code interpreter settings for Open WebUI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_code_execution_config" "example" {
  enable_code_execution      = true
  code_execution_engine      = "jupyter"
  code_execution_jupyter_url = "http://jupyter.internal:8888"
  code_execution_jupyter_auth = "token"
  code_execution_jupyter_auth_token = var.jupyter_token

  enable_code_interpreter    = false
}

variable "jupyter_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code_execution_engine` (String) Code execution engine type, e.g. `jupyter`.
- `code_interpreter_engine` (String) Code interpreter engine type.
- `enable_code_execution` (Boolean) Whether code execution via Jupyter is enabled.
- `enable_code_interpreter` (Boolean) Whether the AI code interpreter feature is enabled.

### Optional

- `code_execution_jupyter_auth` (String) Authentication type for the Jupyter server, e.g. `token` or `password`.
- `code_execution_jupyter_auth_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the Jupyter server. Sensitive.
- `code_execution_jupyter_auth_token` (String, Sensitive) Auth token for the Jupyter server. Sensitive.
- `code_execution_jupyter_timeout` (Number) Request timeout in seconds for the Jupyter server.
- `code_execution_jupyter_url` (String) URL of the Jupyter server used for code execution.
- `code_interpreter_jupyter_auth` (String) Authentication type for the code interpreter Jupyter server.
- `code_interpreter_jupyter_auth_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the code interpreter Jupyter server. Sensitive.
- `code_interpreter_jupyter_auth_token` (String, Sensitive) Auth token for the code interpreter Jupyter server. Sensitive.
- `code_interpreter_jupyter_timeout` (Number) Request timeout in seconds for the code interpreter Jupyter server.
- `code_interpreter_jupyter_url` (String) URL of the Jupyter server used for the code interpreter.
- `code_interpreter_prompt_template` (String) System prompt template used with the code interpreter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier. Set by Open WebUI.
